current_episode.title: Bobby Okereke: The Mindset Behind NFL Success

guest.bio_context: Bobby Okereke was born in the Tustin/Irvine area of Orange County, California, to Nigerian immigrant parents who prioritized education above all else. He became an Eagle Scout after approximately 10 years in the Boy Scouts of America, starting at age 7 and earning the rank at age 17. He played football for the first time in high school — originally told by his mother he could only try out as a kicker — before earning a D1 scholarship from the University of Washington as a junior, reportedly the first player from his high school to earn a D1 scholarship in 20 to 30 years. He attended Stanford University for five years, was named All-Pac-12 his senior year, served as team captain, and was drafted by the Indianapolis Colts with the 89th pick in the third round of the NFL Draft.
